Name: Nymphas
Summary: Nymphas was a believer in whose house a church met, greeted by Paul in Colossians alongside the brethren in Laodicea.
KeyStory: Nymphas was a believer in whose house a church met, greeted by Paul in Colossians alongside the brethren in Laodicea.
LifeLesson: A house opened for the church becomes a church itself.
